အုအူအူးဥဦဦး
သူ ပညာ ထူး၏။
ပထမဆု ရသည်။
ဆု လာယူပါ။
အတု ယူစရာ။
ရာသီဥတု ပူသည်။
ထီး ယူလာသလား။
အနားယူပါ။
ဤမိသားစု
လူစုလာသည်။
ဦးသာထူး ပါသလား။
စားစရာ လာယူပါ။
ညီညီညာညာ လာပါ။
လုမယူရ။
အတူတူ စားပါ။
He is excellent in studies.
He won first prize.
He brought the prize.
He is an example to follow.
The weather is hot.
Did you bring an umbrella?
Uncle comes.
Please rest.
This family
Comes to pay homage.
The crowd gathers.
Is U Tha Htoo included?
Come and take food.
Come in unity.
Do not snatch.
Eat together.
ဘယ်သူ ပညာထူးတာလဲ ကလေးတို့။  --- သူ
ဘယ်သူ လာတာလဲ။  --- ဦးဦး
ဘယ်သူတွေ ဘုရားဖူးလာတာလဲ။  --- ဤမိသားစု
သူက ဘာထူးတာလဲ။  --- ပညာ
သူ ဘာဆု ရတာလဲ။  --- ပထမဆု
စားဖို့အတွက် ဘာကို လာယူရမလဲ။  --- စားစရာ
မိသားစုက ဘာလုပ်ဖို့ လာတာလဲ။  --- ဘုရားဖူးလာတာ
မောပန်းရင် ဘာလုပ်ရမလဲ။  --- အနားယူပါ
စားစရာတွေကို ဘာမလုပ်ရဘူးလဲ။  --- လုမယူရ
လာတဲ့အခါ ဘယ်လို လာရမလဲ။  --- ညီညီညာညာ
စားစရာတွေကို ဘယ်လို စားရမလဲ။  --- အတူတူ
Who excels in education, children? --- He/She.
Who is coming? --- Uncle.
Who came to worship the pagoda? --- This family.
Who is asked if they are included? --- U Thar Htoo.
In what does he excel? --- Education.
What prize did he win? --- First prize.
What are they told to come and collect? --- The prize.
What is asked if it was brought along? --- Umbrella.
What should be fetched to eat? --- Food.
What did the family come for? --- To worship the pagoda.
What should you do if you are tired? --- Take a rest.
What must not be done to the food? --- Do not snatch it away.
How should you come when coming? --- Together in unison.
How should the food be eaten? --- Together.
